bug.symptom: Pretty-printed JSON line breaks displayed as literal backslash-u000a, producing a long single-line detail
bug.cause: Whole formatted JSON passed through generic control-character escaping
bug.fix: HTML-escape and sanitize each formatted JSON line, then join using actual formatter newlines; never unescape input-provided control sequences
bug.regression: New test failed before fix; passes after fix. HTMLParser extracts preformatted text, JSON roundtrips to the stored snapshot and malicious/control-character values remain safe.
